name: io.github.darshjoshi/skyglance
title: SkyGlance — What's Flying Above You
description: Live aircraft overhead with elevation and bearing, aircraft identity, routes, photos, and your own sighting history. Free ADS-B data, no API keys.

environmentVariables.name: SKYGLANCE_HOME_LAT
environmentVariables.description: Your latitude. Enables background sighting history.

environmentVariables.name: SKYGLANCE_HOME_LON
environmentVariables.description: Your longitude. Enables background sighting history.

environmentVariables.name: SKYGLANCE_POLL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable background history recording.
